adds.title: Supreme Court of South Dakota - March 2026 birth certificate ruling
adds.summary: On March 5, 2026 the South Dakota Supreme Court ruled transgender people cannot amend the sex designation on a South Dakota birth certificate to reflect gender identity, affirming denial of Sigrid Nielsen's September 2024 petition to change from male to female, holding a change is permitted only to correct an error made at the time of birth.

adds.title: S.J. 746 (2017) - South Dakota adoption religious exemption law
adds.summary: On March 10, 2017, South Dakota enacted S.B. 149, signed by Gov. Dennis Daugaard, permitting taxpayer-funded foster care and adoption agencies to deny services to LGBT people, including qualified LGBT prospective parents, on religious grounds.
